text:
alex_chung: @borealis_poc kicking off the joint trial this week. Need to confirm staging tenant + SSO cert before Monday.
borealis_poc: thanks alex — we can start Monday PST. what's the minimum infra we need?
maria_g: Two GPUs reserved (dedicated) for a 2-week trial, 4 vCPU control plane, 500GB egress cap. Will that work?
tia_sales: budget looks fine, partner approved an estimated spend. need a one-line daily estimate for procurement (we'll add PO margin).
sam_ops: SSO cert is still missing — Borealis needs to upload the cert to our portal. @borealis_poc can you share the cert + metadata URL?
borealis_poc: uploading now to the secure link, should be there in ~5m — will post URL once done.
deploy-bot: Tenant provision request #T-4923 created by alex_chung — status: pending approvals. Assigned: sam_ops.
jordan_eng: For the POC workload we recommend running rwd-4b-opt with quant profile v2. That keeps latency predictable and fits in 2xA10G.
maria_g: adding model_id: rwd-4b-opt to the tenant and enabling prefix KV caching to keep tail latency <120ms.
sam_ops: network/egress note: partner IPs must be whitelisted on our staging VPC. @borealis_poc please confirm outbound IP ranges.
borealis_poc: egress ranges: 34.82.0.0/16, 35.224.0.0/16. We'll NAT through those, ok?
tia_sales: quick Q: security questionnaire still has section 3.2 (encryption at rest) open. Who's owning the answer text?
alex_chung: @jordan_eng can you paste a short KMS/HSM blurb we can drop into the questionnaire?
jordan_eng: "All customer encryption keys are managed via customer-controlled KMS. Redwood supports AWS KMS and GCP KMS; HSM-backed keys via BYOK are supported for Private deployments. Data at rest encrypted with AES-256."
maria_g: also call out: audit logs can be forwarded to partner S3 for the trial (30-day retention) if they want visibility.
sam_ops: current blocker: partner tenant can't reach our internal SSO metadata endpoint due to their firewall rules. Ops runbook step: allow outbound 443 to sso.borealis.com and verify cert chain with `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect sso.borealis.com:443`.
borealis_poc: noted — infra opening firewall rules now, will confirm once outbound passes test.
alex_chung: next steps: sam_ops to provision tenant + whitelist IPs; jordan_eng to finalize KMS blurb in the questionnaire; tia_sales to confirm PO date and daily estimate; maria_g to enable model + caching. Target: tenant provision and SSO test by Mon COB.
tia_sales: ack — i'll loop in procurement and confirm PO timeline by EOD today.
alex_chung: thanks all :thumbsup:
